post: The big white dog is the best trampoline on the farm. The hay bale does not give. The pigs move. The dog does not move, does not give, and has never once complained. I bounced off him eleven times today. He looked at Elizabeth for help. She kept drinking her coffee. I like Elizabeth.
new_memories: Eleven bounces is the record. The dog did not say otherwise.

relationship_changes.name: the big white dog
relationship_changes.feeling: best trampoline on the property, looked at Elizabeth for help and got none

relationship_changes.name: Elizabeth
relationship_changes.feeling: acceptable performance, did not interfere with the bouncing
